requires: Level 56+; pass Ostraur's test at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire is a room where nothing has ever happened; do one ordinary deed there (sweep, kneel, open a door) and Ostraur's trace will copy it back to you.
secret: You must have finished every task you started for a full month before entering, since Ostraur never left a thing half done.
notice: [Ostraur's trace stirs. Something was done. Legendary class: The Unremarked Mover.]
blurb: Follows Ostraur, the Forgotten Shade of Action, who held the plainest Law behind doing anything at all and then quietly stopped being noticed.
features: Skill: First Motion
You always act in the first round of combat, even when surprised, and you may take the Ready action as a bonus action.
Skill: Implied Deed
Once per short rest, when an ally takes an action, you take the same action type immediately after them without spending your own.
Ultimate: Everything Already Done
Once per long rest, you take three full turns in a row; enemies only notice afterward.
evolves: If you go a year without anyone recording your deeds, you can grant a free action to every ally once per day.
cost: People forget you were there; you never gain renown or reputation from your own deeds.

requires: Level 1+; pass Kazeth's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor a twin-faced statue changes the weather each minute; survive one hour of it wearing nothing chosen for the conditions and Kazeth's second face will turn toward you.
secret: You must have lived in three different climates in the last year, as Kazeth only answers those who already changed to survive.
notice: [The second face opens. You have changed, and lived. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Kazeth, the Twin-Faced Shade of Adaptation, who survived by becoming whatever the land demanded, like the hare that turns white with the snow.
features: Skill: Weathered Hide
After you take damage of a type, you gain resistance to that type until the end of your next turn.
Skill: Second Face
Once per long rest, you gain one sense or movement mode (climb, swim, darkvision) of a creature you saw this day, for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Turned to the Land
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you count as native to any realm, ignoring its Realm Pressure and environmental harm.
evolves: Survive a full year in a realm above your Attunement and the resistance lasts until you take another type.
cost: You cannot keep a set routine; doing the same thing three days running gives disadvantage on checks.

requires: Level 56+; claim a relic of Nydoyr's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the summit of the Heartwood Spire lies Nydoyr's broken abacus; complete its last trial by adding one bead for every foe you have ever slain, without skipping one.
secret: You must have never cheated in a count, wager or trade, since Nydoyr was killed for refusing to round down.
notice: [Bead added. The sum is honest. Legendary class: Tally-Keeper of the Plain Sum.]
blurb: Follows Nydoyr, the Twin-Faced Shade of Add, who held the gentle half of Multiply: plain, patient increase.
features: Skill: One More Bead
Once per turn, add +1 to any roll you or an ally within 30 feet makes after seeing the result.
Skill: Running Total
Each hit you land in a fight adds +1 damage to your next hit, stacking until you miss or the fight ends.
Ultimate: The Honest Sum
Once per long rest, add together every damage roll you made this combat and deal half of it to one creature you can see.
evolves: Recover a second bead of Nydoyr's abacus and your Running Total also adds to allies' damage.
cost: You must count everything aloud; you can never take the Hide action while your total is above zero.

requires: Level 12+; pass Veskaix's test at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire is a door that only opens to those it has seen grow old; wait before it until Veskaix's trace adds a single grey hair to your head.
secret: You must have spent a full day caring for someone dying of old age, the only death Veskaix did not hurry.
notice: [A year passes in a breath. You are older. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Veskaix, the Nameless Shade of Age, opposite of Youth, the Law that arrives without being asked for.
features: Skill: Weight of Years
Creatures you hit lose 10 feet of speed and cannot take reactions until your next turn.
Skill: Elder's Patience
Once per short rest, take the Dodge and Help actions together as a bonus action.
Ultimate: The Unasked Hour
Once per long rest, one creature within 30 feet ages a lifetime in an instant: Constitution save or gain 3 levels of exhaustion.
evolves: When you turn 1.5 times your race's maturity age, your Ultimate affects every enemy within 30 feet.
cost: You age one year for each use of your Ultimate.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Braron's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Braron died halfway up the Fogglass Spire, still walking; at the top his footprints keep going without him. Walk in them with your eyes shut until they stop.
secret: You must enter the tower drunk, lost, or having followed a stranger's directions, as Braron always did.
notice: [A step further than you meant. Legendary class: Stumbling Pilgrim.]
blurb: Follows Braron, the Twin-Faced Shade of Ahead, who nudged people slightly further along whatever path they were already on.
features: Skill: One Step On
Whenever you or an ally moves, you can push that movement 10 feet further in the same direction, ignoring opportunity attacks.
Skill: Already There
Once per short rest, an attack, spell or journey you begin finishes a turn early: the hit lands before the target can react.
Ultimate: Further Along
Once per long rest, push every creature within 30 feet further along its current path: allies gain a free turn, enemies are shoved 30 feet and fall prone.
evolves: Walk a road from one realm's edge to the other without turning back and you may push fate one step, once.
cost: You can never retreat; moving away from a hostile creature halves your speed.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Eirriel's remains at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire Eirriel's last crucible still smokes; brew one potion from ingredients you carried up yourself and drink it unknown. It is her final test.
secret: You must have destroyed your own failed experiments a hundred times and never sold one, as Eirriel did.
notice: [Reaction complete. No god required. Legendary class: Ash-Crucible Adept.]
blurb: Follows Eirriel, the Unknown Shade of Alchemy, who proved materials could become wonders without any godhood at all.
features: Skill: Godless Reagent
You brew a potion in 1 minute from any material; its effect gains bonus equal to the material's Potency.
Skill: Volatile Tincture
As a bonus action, throw a flask: 4d6 acid, fire or poison damage (your choice) in a 10 foot radius.
Ultimate: Grand Transmutation
Once per long rest, change one object up to the size of a cart into a material of the same realm grade.
evolves: Brew Eirriel's lost elixir from Hell-grade materials and your flasks ignore resistance.
cost: Your hands are scarred; you have disadvantage on Sleight of Hand and fine work not involving alchemy.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Varaael's remains at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: On the top floor of the Ledger Spire is the place Varaael was killed for once failing to keep their word; stand there and swear one 'always', then face their last trial by keeping it through the climb down.
secret: You must have kept a single daily habit, without exception, for a year.
notice: [Without fail. Without exception. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Varaael, the Shrouded Shade of Always, opposite of Sometime, a Law claimed far more than earned.
features: Skill: Without Fail
Choose one action you take every turn (an attack, a step, a word); when you take it, it cannot roll below 10.
Skill: Standing Rule
Once per long rest, declare a rule for a 30 foot area for 1 minute (such as 'blades always miss here'); one saving throw ends it per creature.
Ultimate: Forever So
Once per long rest, make one effect lasting 1 minute or less last until you next sleep.
evolves: Keep your 'always' for ten years and it becomes a minor Law you can teach.
cost: If you ever break your sworn 'always', you lose this class until you atone in the tower.

requires: Level 1+; claim a relic of Divine's remains at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire lie the remains of Divine's Shade of Ambulance beside a field of illusory wounded; carry ten of them down a floor without setting one down.
secret: You must have carried a fallen stranger to safety at personal risk, unpaid.
notice: [Nobody left behind. Legendary class: Litter-Bearer of the Red Field.]
blurb: Follows the Forgotten Shade of Ambulance, a Shade of Divine who moved the wounded rather than healed them. Soldiers called it the coward's Law until it saved them.
features: Skill: Lift the Fallen
You can carry a creature at no speed cost; while carrying an ally who cannot move, attacks against you have disadvantage.
Skill: Through the Line
Once per short rest, while carrying someone, move your full speed without provoking or being stopped by any terrain.
Ultimate: No One Left
Once per long rest, every downed ally within 60 feet is moved beside you and stabilized.
evolves: Carry a hundred souls to safety and you may carry a whole squad through a wall of fire once per day.
cost: You can never attack while carrying someone, and soldiers who do not know you call you a coward.

requires: Level 100+; claim a relic of Vessais's remains at the top of the First Spire
unlock: At the summit of the First Spire, Vessais's corpse still holds a drifting hall in place; take its anchor-chain as your last trial and keep the hall still while the tower pushes it away for an hour.
secret: You must have refused, at least once, to leave a place you swore to guard while everyone else fled.
notice: [The drift stops here. Legendary class: Moorstone Warden.]
blurb: Follows Vessais, the Hidden Shade of Anchor, the Law that keeps things from Drift, whether through Time or a bad Fusion.
features: Skill: Hold Fast
You and allies within 10 feet cannot be moved, teleported or banished against your will.
Skill: Moored Law
Spells and effects within 30 feet cannot have their duration, shape or caster changed; you can end this as a reaction.
Ultimate: Drop Anchor
Once per long rest, fix a 60 foot area in place for 1 minute: no time effects, teleportation or transformation work within it.
evolves: Anchor a whole realm's edge for a day and Primordial drift cannot erase what you guard.
cost: You cannot willingly travel more than one realm from the place you first anchored.

requires: Level 1+; pass Kamin's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Kamin's trace at the top of the Milestone Spire is a single coal that never cools; hold it in your bare hand while the tower insults you, and do not drop it until the coal grows tired of you.
secret: You must have once walked away from a fight you could have won, holding the anger inside instead.
notice: [The coal approves. It burns hotter than fear. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Kamin, the Burning Heart of Anger, a splinter of Dark that burns hotter and faster than Fear or Sadness.
features: Skill: Ember Temper
When you take damage, your next attack deals extra fire damage equal to half the damage taken.
Skill: Flash of Kamin
Once per short rest, explode in anger: creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 fire damage and are pushed 10 feet.
Ultimate: Burning Heart
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point and every hit you land sets the target ablaze for 1d6 each turn.
evolves: Forgive someone you truly hate and the fire turns white, never harming allies again.
cost: You cannot calm down; after any fight, make a Wisdom save or lash out at the nearest object or person.

requires: Level 23+; pass Brazeune's test at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire Brazeune left a test: four sealed doors marked plague, famine, war and riding. Open all four and walk out the other side.
secret: You must have survived a plague, a famine and a war, and ridden away from each.
notice: [The end has been seen and survived. Legendary class: Herald of the Fourfold End.]
blurb: Follows Brazeune, the Strange Shade of Apocalypse, keeper of the four Laws ridden together, said to have been used only once.
features: Skill: Four Riders
Each turn choose plague (poisoned), famine (no healing), war (+2 damage taken) or riding (speed halved) for one creature you hit.
Skill: Last Hoofbeat
Once per short rest, apply all four Riders to a creature you hit.
Ultimate: The Once-Used End
Once per lifetime, apply all four Riders to every enemy within a mile for a day.
evolves: If you ever stop an apocalypse rather than cause one, your Ultimate refreshes once.
cost: Wherever you rest, crops fail and milk sours within a week.

requires: Level 1+; pass Ostzeix's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Ostzeix's test at the top of the Milestone Spire is a stair that rises only while you are praying, hoping or helping; reach its end without once looking down.
secret: You must have given away something you needed to someone who would never repay it.
notice: [The stair rises beneath you. Legendary class: Pilgrim of the Upward Stair.]
blurb: Follows Ostzeix, the Twin-Faced Shade of Ascend, opposite of Descend, most often claimed by a soul reaching for Heaven.
features: Skill: Rising Soul
You heal 1 extra hit point per healing die and can stand from prone for no movement.
Skill: Lifted Up
As an action, an ally you touch floats 20 feet up and regains 1d8 hit points.
Ultimate: Upward Stair
Once per long rest, you and allies within 30 feet rise above harm for one round: no damage, then regain hit points equal to your level.
evolves: Climb Heaven's Choir Spire to its summit and your Ultimate grows to two rounds.
cost: Going below ground or into the Abyss gives you disadvantage on everything.

requires: Level 89+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire you find Iron's silent workshop, every piece sorted but none joined; assemble something whole from them without speaking a word, as the Quiet Shade did.
secret: You must have built a working machine from scrap you salvaged yourself.
notice: [Pieces become a whole. Legendary class: Joiner of the Quiet Forge.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Quiet Shade of Assembly, the Mechanical Law of joining pieces into a whole, opposed by Disassembly.
features: Skill: Whole from Parts
Combine two weapons, tools or armour pieces into one item that grants both properties.
Skill: Battle Joiner
As a bonus action, assemble a steel guardian from nearby scrap: AC +2 to an ally and a 2d10 force attack, for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Grand Assembly
Once per long rest, fuse every object within 60 feet into a Huge construct under your control for 1 minute.
evolves: Assemble a whole working city gate from ruins and your constructs persist until destroyed.
cost: You cannot leave a broken thing alone; you must try to fix it before continuing.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Draroane's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Draroane's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire lie split down the middle, each half different; win their last trial, a duel against your own mirror image, by doing what your reflection cannot.
secret: You must fight with your off hand for a week before entering.
notice: [Left and right disagree. Legendary class: The Lopsided Duellist.]
blurb: Follows Draroane, the Hidden Shade of Asymmetry, the opposite of Symmetry, one side never quite matching the other.
features: Skill: Uneven Hands
Your off-hand attacks add your ability modifier and deal a different damage type than your main hand.
Skill: Wrong Side
Once per short rest, an enemy expecting a strike from one side is hit from the other: automatic critical.
Ultimate: Unbalanced World
Once per long rest, enemies within 30 feet have disadvantage on every roll matching their previous one (attack after attack, save after save) for 1 minute.
evolves: Master a different weapon in each hand to level 20 skill and you may wield a third.
cost: Symmetric things repel you; you cannot wear matched pairs of armour or gloves.

requires: Level 100+; claim a relic of Nyriix's remains at the top of the First Spire
unlock: At the summit of the First Spire lies Nyriix's empty divine body; wear it as your last trial and walk one floor down without letting the god it once housed take control.
secret: You must hold a contract of at least Minor with a god.
notice: [Divine form accepted. Legendary class: Vessel of the Borrowed God.]
blurb: Follows Nyriix, the Shrouded Shade of Avatar, the temporary body a god wears in the Mortal Realm, never as strong as its source.
features: Skill: Borrowed Shape
Once per long rest, wear a divine shape for 10 minutes: become Large, gain +1 AC and 50 temporary hit points.
Skill: Lent Miracle
While in your shape, cast one spell your patron god knows as if you had it prepared.
Ultimate: Full Descent
Once per lifetime, your patron god descends into you for 1 minute with its full power.
evolves: Hold a 1st Finger contract and your Ultimate may be used once per year.
cost: Gods can borrow your body for one hour per month without asking.

requires: Level 1+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Milestone Spire is a felling axe in a stump; cut through the stump with one swing, after spending a day there in silence.
secret: You must have felled a tree with your own hands for a home, not for sale.
notice: [Heavy and quiet. Legendary class: Woodcleaver of the Silent Grove.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Quiet Shade of Axe, who gave weight to the edge in place of speed.
features: Skill: Heavy Edge
Your axe attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage and push the target 5 feet.
Skill: Clean Chop
Once per short rest, sever a limb, shield or weapon of a creature you hit (Constitution save).
Ultimate: Felling Stroke
Once per long rest, one strike deals triple damage and knocks the target prone.
evolves: Wield an Iron-grade axe in a hundred fights and your Felling Stroke cleaves a line of enemies.
cost: You are slow; you have -5 feet of speed while carrying an axe.

requires: Level 45+; claim a relic of Iron's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: Iron's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire are a perfect sphere of metal; complete the last trial by rolling it up the final ramp while the tower pushes it back.
secret: You must have broken a wall with a thrown object.
notice: [Round, rolling, unstoppable. Legendary class: Rolling Siege.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Forgotten Shade of Ball, holder of the most basic thrown shape, kin to Projectile.
features: Skill: Round Shot
Anything you throw counts as a magic weapon dealing 2d8 bludgeoning, and bounces to a second target.
Skill: Gathering Roll
Each 10 feet a thrown object travels adds 1d6 damage, up to 6d6.
Ultimate: Siege Sphere
Once per long rest, hurl a Huge ball of metal: 10d10 damage in a line 100 feet long.
evolves: Hurl a sphere into the Abyss and catch it on its return to make it return every time.
cost: You cannot hold anything round without throwing it within an hour.

n: Wailing Widow of the Hollow Hill
requires: Level 78+; pass Life's test at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire Life's trace is a voice with no mouth; answer its wail with your own grief until it falls silent.
secret: You must have mourned someone whose body was never recovered.
notice: [A cry heard across worlds. Legendary class awakened.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Forgotten Shade of Banshee, a Specter bound to Grief who fought with its wail rather than anything physical.
features: Skill: Keening
As an action, wail: creatures in a 30 foot cone take 4d8 psychic damage and are frightened (Wisdom save).
Skill: Bodiless Grief
Once per short rest, become incorporeal for 1 minute, passing through objects.
Ultimate: Death-Cry
Once per long rest, wail so that a creature below a quarter of its hit points dies (Constitution save, 10d10 psychic on a success).
evolves: Forgive the death that bound you and your wail can call souls back for one hour.
cost: You cannot speak above a whisper except to wail.

requires: Level 100+; claim a relic of Undine's remains at the top of the First Spire
unlock: Undine's remains rest in a still spring at the top of the First Spire; bathe in it at dawn as her last trial, and do not flinch when it shows your every sin.
secret: You must have fasted for three days and cleansed someone else before entering.
notice: [Washed clean. Legendary class: Rite-Bather of the First Spring.]
blurb: Follows Undine, the Strange Shade of Bathe, a minor ritual Law of washing paired with Purity rites.
features: Skill: Ritual Wash
As an action, cleanse a creature of one curse, poison or disease.
Skill: Purifying Water
Once per short rest, a 20 foot pool cleanses creatures that enter of all conditions.
Ultimate: First Spring
Once per long rest, flood a 100 foot area: allies are healed 6d8, undead and fiends take 10d8 radiant.
evolves: Bathe a god in its own temple and its contract with you deepens one step.
cost: You must bathe every day or lose your class features until you do.

n: Berserk Headsman of the Unlit Hall
requires: Level 89+; claim a relic of Iron's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: Iron's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire grip a great axe no one can lift; as the last trial, lift it after forgetting every floor below you.
secret: You must have fought on after losing consciousness once.
notice: [Weight claimed. Legendary class: Berserk Headsman of the Unlit Hall.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Forgotten Shade of Battle Axe, who gave up speed for a hammer's weight.
features: Skill: Hammer-Weight
Two-handed axe hits deal an extra 2d6 and knock Large or smaller foes prone.
Skill: Blind Swing
While raging or below half hit points, you cannot be frightened and ignore cover.
Ultimate: Unlit Cleave
Once per long rest, swing through every creature within 15 feet, dealing maximum damage.
evolves: Fell a god's avatar with the axe and it gains a will of its own.
cost: You cannot use shields or wield light weapons.

requires: Level 34+; claim a relic of Branias's remains at the top of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire Branias's remains are curled around an empty hearth; as her last trial, gather a party who would follow you into the shuffled floors and keep them together until the hearth lights.
secret: You must have welcomed a stranger or beast into your home for a season.
notice: [You are held. Legendary class: Hearthward of the Gathered.]
blurb: Follows Branias, the Tender Heart of Belonging, a splinter of Light: feeling held rather than feeling for.
features: Skill: Kept Close
Allies within 10 feet of you cannot be charmed or frightened.
Skill: Call Home
Once per short rest, teleport an ally or bonded beast to your side.
Ultimate: Gathered Hearth
Once per long rest, allies within 60 feet share hit points with you for 1 minute, splitting damage evenly.
evolves: Hold a family together across three realms and your Hearth reaches one mile.
cost: Alone, you weaken; you have disadvantage on all rolls without an ally in sight.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Zetaar's remains at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: Zetaar was killed by the one who trusted them most; at the top of the Ledger Spire, their last trial asks you to betray a tower-made companion who has saved you twice.
secret: You must have been betrayed by a close friend and not yet taken revenge.
notice: [Trust broken. Legendary class: The Knife in Trust.]
blurb: Follows Zetaar, the Restless Heart of Betrayal, Dark's answer to Trust, the splinter that can exist only after its opposite.
features: Skill: Borrowed Faith
Creatures that consider you an ally take double damage from your first hit each fight.
Skill: Turned Coat
Once per short rest, you appear allied to an enemy for 1 minute (Wisdom save ends on damage).
Ultimate: Final Knife
Once per long rest, a hit on a creature that trusted you is a critical that ignores resistance.
evolves: Earn the forgiveness of the one you betrayed and the class becomes a guardian against traitors.
cost: Animals and children refuse to trust you.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Quosaiel's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Quosaiel's remains at the top of the Choir Spire fill the whole hall; climb their final trial, the body itself, to its crown.
secret: You must have once refused to accept anything smaller than what was promised.
notice: [More. Larger. Legendary class: Swollen Titan.]
blurb: Follows Quosaiel, the Forgotten Shade of Bigger, opposite of Smaller, the Law that enlarges objects.
features: Skill: Grow Weapon
As a bonus action, enlarge a weapon: it deals an extra die of damage for 1 minute.
Skill: Larger Than Life
Once per short rest, become Large for 1 minute with advantage on Strength checks.
Ultimate: Swollen Titan
Once per long rest, become Huge for 1 minute: +3d6 damage, reach 15 feet.
evolves: Grow a whole fortress twice its size and you can reach Gargantuan.
cost: You always need double rations and space.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Bralear's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Bralear's corpse at the top of the Choir Spire is wrapped in knotted cords; untie their final knot without cutting it, while a choir sings to confuse you.
secret: You must have broken a curse without breaking the thing it was bound to.
notice: [The knot holds. Legendary class: Knotted Seal-Warden.]
blurb: Follows Bralear, the Shrouded Shade of Bind, gentler cousin of Chain, holding a Law in place rather than a person.
features: Skill: Tie Off
As a reaction, stop a spell's effect from spreading or moving.
Skill: Knotted Ward
Once per short rest, a creature you touch cannot use one Law of your choice for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Final Knot
Once per long rest, bind every spell within 60 feet in place for 1 minute; no new spells can be cast.
evolves: Bind an unclaimed Rune and it may choose you.
cost: You cannot unknot anything without a full rest.

requires: Level 45+; pass Nyleth's test at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the top of the Sunken Spire Nyleth left a test: a room of pure black ink where you must find a single white thread by touch.
secret: You must have worn only black for a year.
notice: [Ink accepts ink. Legendary class: Inkwell Shade.]
blurb: Follows Nyleth, the Strange Shade of Black, opposite of White and only loosely tied to Dark.
features: Skill: Ink-Dark
You are invisible in dim light and darkness to creatures that cannot see through it.
Skill: Stain
Once per short rest, stain a creature: it loses its colours and can't hide or blend in for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Blackout
Once per long rest, all light within 120 feet is extinguished for 1 minute; you see normally.
evolves: Find Nyleth's white twin and you can turn any colour into a weapon.
cost: Bright light stings you; disadvantage on attacks in sunlight.

requires: Level 78+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Hollow Spire is a sword whose edge appears only when you need it; your test is to fight with a blunt bar until it grows an edge.
secret: You must have sharpened a thousand blades for others.
notice: [An edge is imposed. Legendary class: Edge-Giver of Soft Metal.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Unknown Shade of Blade, who drew an edge from metal that would not otherwise hold one.
features: Skill: Imposed Edge
Any metal object becomes a magic weapon dealing 1d10 slashing.
Skill: Weapon Lesson
Once per short rest, an ally's next three hits deal an extra 2d6 slashing.
Ultimate: Ten Thousand Edges
Once per long rest, every metal object within 60 feet becomes a blade that strikes a foe of your choice for 2d10.
evolves: Forge an edge onto Void metal and your blades cut Laws.
cost: Your own skin grows hard and edged; you cannot embrace or be healed by touch.

requires: Level 100+; claim a relic of Thalnour's remains at the top of the First Spire
unlock: Thalnour's corpse at the top of the First Spire still bleeds; as their last trial, stop the bleeding without any healing magic.
secret: You must have survived a wound that took a month to close.
notice: [The wound remembers. Legendary class: Red Wound Hunter.]
blurb: Follows Thalnour, the Shrouded Shade of Bleed, a lingering wound Law, slower and harder to fix than Hurt.
features: Skill: Lingering Cut
Your hits cause bleeding: 1d6 damage at the start of each turn until healed.
Skill: Opened Vein
Once per short rest, one bleeding creature takes all remaining bleed damage at once, doubled.
Ultimate: Red Tide
Once per long rest, every bleeding creature within 120 feet takes 10d10 damage.
evolves: Survive a wound from a god and your bleeding cannot be healed by gods.
cost: Your own wounds never fully close; you heal half from magic.

requires: Level 89+; claim a relic of Osttan's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: Osttan's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire rest in a field of dead grain; as the last trial, plant a seed there that grows into something new from the blight.
secret: You must have farmed land others called cursed.
notice: [The field turns. Legendary class: Rot-Field Shepherd.]
blurb: Follows Osttan, the Strange Shade of Blight, the Nature cousin of Decay that claims crops and forests.
features: Skill: Wilting Touch
Plants and plant creatures you touch take 4d8 necrotic damage and wither.
Skill: Blighted Ground
Once per short rest, a 30 foot area becomes blighted: enemies' healing is halved there.
Ultimate: Spreading Rot
Once per long rest, blight a mile around you: enemies there cannot heal for a day.
evolves: Turn blight back into bloom and you gain a druid's command over growth.
cost: Plants wilt where you sleep.

requires: Level 78+; pass Life's test at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Life's trace at the top of the Hollow Spire is a river of blood still moving; your test is to swim against its current to its source.
secret: You must have given your own blood to save a life.
notice: [Blood moves. Legendary class: Vein-Reader of the Running Tide.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Veiled Keeper of Blood, thick with power while it moves and worthless once it stops.
features: Skill: Living Current
While you are at full health, your attacks deal an extra 2d6.
Skill: Blood-Call
Once per short rest, pull blood from a creature within 30 feet: 4d8 damage, you heal the same.
Ultimate: Tide Unstopped
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your blood becomes a weapon: each hit you take deals that damage to the attacker.
evolves: Gather Life's other traces and your blood can raise the recently dead.
cost: Each use of Blood-Call costs 1d4 of your own hit points.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Rymin's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Rymin's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire are a sleeping tree; as their last trial, tend it for a whole day without forcing a single bud.
secret: You must have raised a beast companion from birth.
notice: [A gentle bloom. Legendary class: Slow-Bloom Ranger.]
blurb: Follows Rymin, the Shrouded Shade of Blossom, the gentler, slower Bloom favoured by Nature work.
features: Skill: Gentle Petals
Your beast companion regains 1d6 hit points each turn while you stand near it.
Skill: Slow Bloom
Once per short rest, a flowering vine restrains an enemy for 1 minute (Strength save).
Ultimate: Full Bloom
Once per long rest, a 60 foot garden springs up: allies heal 2d8 each turn for 1 minute.
evolves: Plant Rymin's seed in Heaven and your blossoms heal the undead.
cost: You can't harm plants; doing so ends your features until dawn.

requires: Level 34+; claim a relic of Life's remains at the top of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: Life's remains at the top of the Shuffled Spire are a hall of bones that reshuffles; your last trial is to assemble one complete skeleton in the chaos.
secret: You must have buried a hundred dead with your own hands.
notice: [Bones rise for you. Legendary class: Ossuary Lord.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Forgotten Shade of Bones, the part of a Corpse that outlasts Decay.
features: Skill: Lasting Frame
Undead you summon have double hit points.
Skill: Bone Wall
Once per short rest, raise a 30 foot wall of bones that blocks and attacks.
Ultimate: Ossuary March
Once per long rest, raise every skeleton within a mile to fight for 1 hour.
evolves: Raise a dragon's bones and they keep their breath.
cost: Your bones are brittle; you take double bludgeoning damage.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Orshaor's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Orshaor blew themself up at the top of the Fogglass Spire; as their last trial, gather the scattered sparks and set them off in a single blast.
secret: You must have destroyed something on purpose that everyone else wanted preserved.
notice: [KABOOM. Legendary class: Thunderclap Rioter.]
blurb: Follows Orshaor, the Unknown Shade of Boom, a blunt release Law that needs no subtlety.
features: Skill: Big Bang
As an action, explode for 4d6 thunder in a 10 foot radius.
Skill: Blast Jump
Once per short rest, explode beneath you to leap 60 feet.
Ultimate: Final Detonation
Once per long rest, detonate a 60 foot radius for 10d10 damage.
evolves: Survive your own detonation without healing and the next becomes cataclysmic.
cost: You're always loud; disadvantage on Stealth.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Eirshaeth's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Eirshaeth's remains at the top of the Choir Spire are a struck note still ringing; as their last trial, harmonise with it until the choir joins you.
secret: You must have inspired a stranger to finish a task they meant to abandon.
notice: [Surge granted. Legendary class: Brief-Surge Bard.]
blurb: Follows Eirshaeth, the Forgotten Shade of Boost, a blunt temporary Grow, useful precisely because it fades.
features: Skill: Quick Surge
As a bonus action, an ally gains +2 to hit and +1d6 damage until your next turn.
Skill: Crescendo
Once per short rest, all allies within 30 feet gain 2d10 temporary hit points.
Ultimate: Peak Moment
Once per long rest, one ally gets maximum results on every roll for one turn.
evolves: Boost a mortal to defeat a god and your boosts last a minute.
cost: After each use your own power drains; disadvantage on your next attack.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Sylph's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire lies Boreas's frozen body; as his final trial, survive a winter storm of his wrath and refuse to bow before it.
secret: You must have lost a mother or mentor and borne it in anger.
notice: [The north wind remembers. Legendary class: Winter's Spiteful Child.]
blurb: Follows Boreas, the Strange Shade of Boreas, the harsh winter wind, son of Sylph, with power enough to challenge a god.
features: Skill: North Gale
As an action, a 60 foot cone of icy wind deals 3d8 cold and pushes 15 feet.
Skill: Hard Frost
Once per short rest, enemies within 30 feet are slowed for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Season-Bringer
Once per long rest, bring winter to a mile for a day.
evolves: Reconcile with Sylph's memory and you can bring any season.
cost: You are cold to all warmth; healing magic heals you half.

requires: Level 23+; pass Gnome's test at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: Gnome's trace at the top of the Ledger Spire is a rack of unnamed bows; your test is to name each one and shoot it true.
secret: You must have built every bow you have used.
notice: [Strings sing. Legendary class: Many-Stringed Fletcher.]
blurb: Follows Gnome, the Nameless Shade of Bows, the plural shape behind every bow no one has named yet.
features: Skill: Any Bow
You are proficient with all bows and can use any one as a magic weapon.
Skill: Nameless Draw
Once per short rest, invent a bow shape: its arrows gain an effect you choose (fire, piercing walls).
Ultimate: Rack of Wonders
Once per long rest, summon every bow you named; each shoots once for 2d10.
evolves: Name a hundred bows and you become their legend.
cost: You can't use other ranged weapons.

requires: Level 89+; pass Hazeor's test at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire Hazeor's trace is a boy who forgets you every few minutes; your test is to make him laugh three times.
secret: You must have protected a child from danger.
notice: [Youth remains. Legendary class: Ever-Lad of the Unlit Playground.]
blurb: Follows Hazeor, the Shrouded Shade of Boy, a category of Youth rather than a Law of its own.
features: Skill: Young Heart
You cannot be frightened or aged.
Skill: Child's Play
Once per short rest, play a game with a creature: on a loss, it is stunned 1 round.
Ultimate: Ever-Lad
Once per long rest, reset to full hit points and remove all conditions, as if new.
evolves: Raise a child who becomes great and you can give them your youth.
cost: Adults dismiss your words; disadvantage on Persuasion with elders.

requires: Level 56+; pass Life's test at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Life's trace at the top of the Heartwood Spire is a statue holding up the tower's ceiling; your test is to take its place for an hour.
secret: You must have held a doorway or bridge alone against many.
notice: [The stance holds. Legendary class: Unbowed Sentinel.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Forgotten Shade of Brace, who held a stance rather than blocking a strike.
features: Skill: Planted Feet
You can't be pushed or knocked prone; +1 AC while you haven't moved this turn.
Skill: Held Line
Once per short rest, take an ally's hit for them, halving it.
Ultimate: Unbowed
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you can't drop below 1 hit point while standing still.
evolves: Brace through a realm-shaking event and +2 AC becomes permanent.
cost: You can't dash while braced.

requires: Level 100+; claim a relic of Varaiel's remains at the top of the First Spire
unlock: Varaiel's remains at the top of the First Spire are a pillar of unbreakable stone; as their last trial, break it with your bare hands.
secret: You must have broken every weapon you've owned.
notice: [Broken. Legendary class: Shatterfist of the First Stone.]
blurb: Follows Varaiel, the Hidden Shade of Break, the blunt end of Hurt, aimed at things not people.
features: Skill: Shatter
Your hits deal double damage to objects and constructs.
Skill: Sundering Strike
Once per short rest, break armour or a shield: the target loses its AC bonus.
Ultimate: First Break
Once per long rest, break any one object, even a magic item.
evolves: Break a god's weapon and you can break Laws.
cost: You can't hold fragile items without them cracking.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Iron's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Iron's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire are a bronze anvil; as his last trial, forge a blade of bronze that holds against iron.
secret: You must have repaired an old heirloom rather than replace it.
notice: [The old metal holds. Legendary class: Old-Metal Smith.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Unknown Shade of Bronze, an older, softer metal kept for Blacksmith work.
features: Skill: Soft Start
You can work any metal at half the time, starting soft.
Skill: Tempered Bronze
Once per short rest, harden a bronze weapon: +2 damage for an hour.
Ultimate: Bronze Age
Once per long rest, all metal within 60 feet softens to bronze for 1 minute.
evolves: Forge a bronze item at Hell grade and it cannot rust or break.
cost: Iron rejects you; you can't use iron weapons.

requires: Level 1+; claim a relic of Haroos's remains at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Haroos's remains at the top of the Milestone Spire sit inside an open cage; as his last trial, coax a wild beast into it without harming it.
secret: You must have freed a caged creature that could have hurt you.
notice: [Held, not hurt. Legendary class: Gentle Jailer.]
blurb: Follows Haroos, the Hidden Shade of Cage, a binding shape used to hold rather than to hurt.
features: Skill: Bars of Law
As an action, cage a Medium creature within 30 feet (Strength save) until your next turn.
Skill: Soft Bars
Creatures you cage take no damage from any source while caged.
Ultimate: Great Cage
Once per long rest, cage a Large creature for 1 minute.
evolves: Cage something that wanted out for a decade and your cages can hold spirits.
cost: You must free a caged creature whenever you see one.

requires: Level 78+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Hollow Spire is a gauge that never quite reads true; your test is to calibrate it in total silence.
secret: You must have redone a finished work because it was off by a hair.
notice: [Adjusted. Legendary class: Fine-Tuner of the Hollow Gauge.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Twin-Faced Shade of Calibration, the act of chasing Precision rather than holding it.
features: Skill: Adjust
After you miss, your next attack against the same target gains +5.
Skill: True Reading
Once per short rest, learn a creature's exact AC, hit points and resistances.
Ultimate: Perfect Tune
Once per long rest, your next three attacks hit automatically.
evolves: Calibrate a Void engine and you can tune others' weapons as well.
cost: Never satisfied; you cannot take a long rest without fixing one thing.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Zeluur's remains at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: Zeluur was killed hiding at the top of the Ledger Spire; their last trial is to stand in that empty hall unseen while the Ledger's clerks search for you.
secret: You must have spent a full day in the wild without any creature noticing you.
notice: [Unseen. Legendary class: Thicket-Skin Stalker.]
blurb: Follows Zeluur, the Hidden Shade of Camouflage, the Nature cousin of Mask that hides a whole creature.
features: Skill: Blend
You can hide in plain sight while standing still in natural terrain.
Skill: Ambush Colour
Your first attack from hiding each fight deals an extra 3d6.
Ultimate: Vanish into Land
Once per long rest, become invisible to all senses for 1 minute.
evolves: Hide from a god and you can hide allies too.
cost: Your skin shifts colour; you look unsettling to others.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Time's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Time's remains at the top of the Choir Spire hold a thread tied from cause to effect; as the last trial, trace it from its end to its beginning.
secret: You must have undone a mistake by fixing its cause rather than its result.
notice: [Cause bound to effect. Legendary class: Knot-Reader of Cause.]
blurb: Follows Time, the Hidden Shade of Causality, the Void Law binding cause to effect, which Time and Reverse both obey.
features: Skill: See the Thread
Once per turn, after a creature acts you learn why, and gain +2 to your next roll against it.
Skill: Bound Effect
Once per short rest, tie your hit to an ally's: whatever damage they deal, the target takes again.
Ultimate: Severed Cause
Once per long rest, undo one event from the last round as if it never had a cause.
evolves: Untangle a knot of Time and you can see an hour ahead.
cost: Every effect you cause is felt by you; you take 1 psychic per action.

requires: Level 1+; pass Ornoyr's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire Ornoyr's trace is a chain anchored in nothing; your test is to wear it all the way down without breaking it.
secret: You must have been chained or imprisoned and escaped.
notice: [Chained to power. Legendary class: Fettered Champion.]
blurb: Follows Ornoyr, the Quiet Shade of Chain, heavier cousin of Lock, meant to hold a person or god down.
features: Skill: Iron Links
A chain you wield reaches 10 feet and can grapple.
Skill: Fetter
Once per short rest, chain a creature in place.
Ultimate: Chain the God
Once per long rest, chain a creature of any size for a round.
evolves: Chain a demon and you can bind its power to your weapon.
cost: You are always shackled at the wrist; Dexterity checks at disadvantage.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Zesan's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Zesan's remains at the top of the Choir Spire are a shape that won't stay still; as their last trial, tell the remains you will change yourself, then do so in front of the choir.
secret: You must have changed your name or role completely once.
notice: [Different afterward. Legendary class: Shifting Mantle.]
blurb: Follows Zesan, the Strange Shade of Change, general cousin of Transformation, without demanding permanence.
features: Skill: Small Change
As a bonus action, change your size, weight or colour.
Skill: Shift Form
Once per short rest, become a beast you've seen for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Change the World
Once per long rest, change one thing about a creature (type, size, a trait) for a day.
evolves: Change a god's mind and you can change permanently.
cost: You never look the same twice; people forget your face.

requires: Level 23+; pass Dranour's test at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Dranour's test at the top of the Choir Spire is a mirror showing your own death; step through it and return weaker but whole.
secret: You must have died once and come back.
notice: [You fell, and kept going. Legendary class: The Once-Fallen.]
blurb: Follows Dranour, the Shrouded Shade of Character Death, by whose Law the fallen rise again only a little weaker.
features: Skill: Second Life
When you drop to 0 hit points, drop to 1 instead once per long rest.
Skill: Lesson of Death
After you fall, you gain +2 to all rolls against the creature that felled you.
Ultimate: Come Back
Once per lifetime, return from death without lowering any stat.
evolves: Die three times and you can grant Second Life to another.
cost: Each death permanently lowers your highest stat by 1.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Variael's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Variael's remains at the top of the Choir Spire are a sweet perfume; as the last trial, win the choir's favour with only a smile.
secret: You must have made an enemy into a friend.
notice: [Sweetness accepted. Legendary class: Honey-Tongued Heartstealer.]
blurb: Follows Variael, the Strange Shade of Charm, softer cousin of Instigate, provoking affection rather than anger.
features: Skill: Warm Glance
Creatures that see you can't attack you on their first turn (Wisdom save).
Skill: Heart Theft
Once per short rest, charm a creature for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Adoring Crowd
Once per long rest, every creature within 60 feet is charmed for 1 minute.
evolves: Charm a god and you gain its favour.
cost: You can't refuse a heartfelt plea.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Divine's remains at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Divine's remains at the top of the Choir Spire rest under a sealed veil; as the last trial, refuse temptation in the choir hall for a full night.
secret: You must have refused a love or comfort for a holy cause.
notice: [Purity confirmed. Legendary class: Unwed Templar.]
blurb: Follows Divine, the Hidden Shade of Chastity, a narrow refusal within Purity that the church values more than its god ever asked.
features: Skill: Refusal
You're immune to charm and seduction.
Skill: Sealed Heart
Once per short rest, deal 2d10 radiant to a creature that tried to tempt you.
Ultimate: Pure Refusal
Once per long rest, no creature within 30 feet can be charmed or compelled for 1 minute.
evolves: Hold your vow ten years and gain radiant resistance.
cost: You may never marry or take a lover.

requires: Level 1+; pass Ishmith's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire Ishmith's trace is a bubbling vat; your test is to make it react safely without burning or cutting.
secret: You must have caused an accidental explosion and survived.
notice: [Reaction complete. Legendary class: Reaction-Born Tinker.]
blurb: Follows Ishmith, the Nameless Shade of Chemical, the Alchemy-adjacent Law of things that react.
features: Skill: Mix
As a bonus action, combine two items into a reactive flask: 1d10 acid.
Skill: Catalyst
Once per short rest, double any potion's effect.
Ultimate: Chain Reaction
Once per long rest, set off every flask within 60 feet for 6d6.
evolves: Mix a material from another realm and your reactions grow stronger.
cost: Your clothes always smell; disadvantage on Stealth.

requires: Level 1+; pass Time's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Time's trace at the top of the Milestone Spire is a crossroads where both roads are real; your test is to choose one aloud, then live with what the other road shows you in a dream that night.
secret: You must have once refused to let a seer, priest or parent decide your path for you.
notice: [Two paths were open. You chose. Legendary class: Walker of the Open Fork.]
blurb: Follows Time, the Nameless Shade of Choice, the Law behind a moment where more than one path is truly open, rare enough that Fate usually denies it.
features: Skill: Second Road
Once per short rest, after you roll a d20, roll again and choose which result happened.
Skill: Unfated
You have advantage on saves against divination, prophecy and effects that would decide your actions for you.
Ultimate: Fork in the Hour
Once per long rest, declare two plans for your turn; play out the first, then decide whether to keep it or rewind and take the second.
evolves: Defy a written prophecy and win, and Second Road works for allies within 30 feet.
cost: Fate's servants notice you; seers and oracles refuse to read for you, and some hunt you.

requires: Level 78+; pass Aelriyr's test at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Aelriyr's trace at the top of the Hollow Spire is a lectern holding a book with blank pages where the Void has eaten every word; your test is to write the tower's history from memory with ink you brought yourself.
secret: You must have preserved a legend by writing it down after the last person who told it died.
notice: [It is written. It will outlast you. Legendary class: Last Annalist of the Hollow.]
blurb: Follows Aelriyr, the Nameless Shade of Chronicles, keeper of the written record that outlives whatever Legend or god it was about.
features: Skill: Read the Margins
Touch an object or corpse to read a page of its history: who held it last and what they did.
Skill: Recorded Deed
Once per short rest, write an ally's last action into your book; on their next turn they repeat it for free.
Ultimate: Revised Edition
Once per long rest, rewrite one event from the last minute: one hit becomes a miss or one failed save becomes a success.
evolves: Finish a chronicle of a dead god and your book can summon that god's echo once.
cost: Anything you do not write down by nightfall you forget.

requires: Level 89+; claim a relic of Ulluth's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: Ulluth's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire still smile in a room where climbers forget everything; as their last trial, remember the whole climb clearly and say it back to them.
secret: You must have pulled a friend out of madness, charm or despair with words alone.
notice: [The fog lifts. Legendary class: Unclouded Witness.]
blurb: Follows Ulluth, the Smiling Heart of Clarity, a splinter of Light that clears rather than warms, opposite of Confusion.
features: Skill: Clear Sight
You see through illusions, invisibility and disguises within 60 feet.
Skill: Lifted Fog
Once per short rest, end charmed, frightened and confused on every ally within 30 feet.
Ultimate: The Plain Answer
Once per long rest, ask the DM one question; the answer is true and complete.
evolves: Clear the mind of a mad god and you can share Clear Sight with your whole party.
cost: You cannot be fooled even when you want to be; you see every kind lie.

requires: Level 1+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Milestone Spire is a soot-black anvil in a clean room; your test is to scrub it bright with water and sand alone, without leaving a single smudge on the floor.
secret: You must have spent a season cleaning a smithy or alchemist's shop without pay.
notice: [Spotless. Legendary class: Scourer of the Forge.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Hidden Shade of Clean, opposite of Dirty, rarely wielded outside smithing or alchemy.
features: Skill: Scour
As an action, remove rust, grime, poison or a minor curse from an object or creature you touch.
Skill: Bright Steel
Your weapons and armour never rust or dull, and once per short rest you can end the poisoned condition on yourself.
Ultimate: Clean Slate
Once per long rest, remove every condition and lingering effect from an ally.
evolves: Scour a cursed relic clean and it becomes yours to wield without its curse.
cost: Filth unsettles you; you have disadvantage on rolls while dirty or bloodied.

requires: Level 45+; pass Rykaiel's test at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: Rykaiel's trace at the bottom of the Sunken Spire is a hall of perfect copies of you, none alive; your test is to find which one is breathing, and it is not you.
secret: You must have met someone who looked exactly like you.
notice: [Shape copied. Spirit not included. Legendary class: Shell-Maker of the Deep Mirror.]
blurb: Follows Rykaiel, the Shrouded Shade of Clone, who copied shapes without the Life or Spirit that gives them meaning.
features: Skill: Hollow Copy
As an action, create a copy of yourself with 1 hit point; it can move and take the Help or Dodge action.
Skill: Empty Crowd
Once per short rest, make three Hollow Copies; attackers must guess which is you.
Ultimate: Borrowed Shell
Once per long rest, copy a creature you see for 1 minute; the shell has its stats but obeys you.
evolves: Give a copy a spark of your Spirit and it can act on its own for a day.
cost: Your copies hold grudges; one in ten turns on you.

requires: Level 12+; pass Sylph's test at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Sylph's trace at the top of the Fogglass Spire is one drifting cloud indoors; your test is to follow it through the mirror-halls until it lets you sit on it.
secret: You must have been truly lost in fog and found your way out without help.
notice: [Breath of Sylph accepted. Legendary class: Mistborne Drifter.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Nameless Shade of Cloud, drifting vapor from Sylph's breath, too thin for Storm and too restless for Sky.
features: Skill: Vapor Veil
As a bonus action, wrap yourself in mist: attacks against you have disadvantage until your next turn.
Skill: False Shapes
Once per short rest, sculpt the fog into a convincing illusion up to 30 feet across for 10 minutes.
Ultimate: Cloudwalk
Once per long rest, you and four allies become mist for 1 minute, flying at 60 feet and immune to weapon damage.
evolves: Ride a cloud between two realms and you can summon one to carry you anywhere once per day.
cost: You can never stay dry; your gear rusts and your scrolls blur.

requires: Level 67+; pass Varath's test at the top of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire Varath's trace is an empty knight's seat facing a horizon; your test is to recite your own code there and keep it while the tower tempts you to break it.
secret: You must have lost something of value because you refused to break a personal rule.
notice: [Your word has weight here. Legendary class: Oathbound Errant.]
blurb: Follows Varath, the Nameless Shade of Code, the self-imposed rules worth nothing as a Law and everything as a reputation.
features: Skill: Spoken Rules
Write three personal rules; while you keep all three you gain +1 to attacks and saves.
Skill: Renowned Name
Once per short rest, a creature that knows your reputation must surrender, flee or parley (Wisdom save).
Ultimate: Unbroken Word
Once per long rest, an ally who swears by your code gains your Spoken Rules bonus doubled for 1 minute.
evolves: Keep your code for a decade and it becomes a minor Law others can swear by.
cost: Break one rule and your features end until you atone publicly.

requires: Level 56+; claim a relic of Sylph's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Sylph's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire are a wind that keeps tearing itself apart; as her last trial, hold two halves of it together until they stay.
secret: You must have kept a group together that was about to break apart.
notice: [Joined, and held. Legendary class: Seam-Binder.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Hidden Shade of Cohesion, the Law that keeps a Fusion from falling back apart.
features: Skill: Hold Together
Allies within 10 feet of you cannot be split, polymorphed or dismembered against their will.
Skill: Mending Seam
Once per short rest, a creature or object you touch regains 4d8 hit points as it pulls back together.
Ultimate: Unbreakable Whole
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your party shares one pool of hit points equal to their combined total.
evolves: Hold a failing Fusion together and you may fuse two items permanently.
cost: You feel every split near you; disadvantage on concentration when allies are separated.

requires: Level 56+; claim a relic of Iron's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Iron's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire are a comet stopped in mid-fall; as its last trial, stand in its path and let it finish falling through you.
secret: You must have watched a falling star and travelled to where it landed.
notice: [Trajectory accepted. Legendary class: Falling-Star Courier.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Nameless Shade of Comet, a Projectile big enough to borrow from Star.
features: Skill: Tail of Light
Your thrown weapons and projectiles leave a trail of light that deals an extra 2d6 radiant.
Skill: Starfall Dive
Once per short rest, leap and land within 120 feet: 6d6 radiant in a 15 foot radius.
Ultimate: Long Arc
Once per long rest, call down a comet within a mile: 15d10 fire and radiant in a 40 foot radius.
evolves: Catch a falling star unburnt and you can ride your own comet across a realm.
cost: Your path is fixed; once you start moving you can't change direction until you stop.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Rysath's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Rysath's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire are a pebble that weighs as much as the tower; as their last trial, carry it up one flight.
secret: You must have packed everything you own into a single bag.
notice: [Compressed. Legendary class: Dense-Core Shaper.]
blurb: Follows Rysath, the Forgotten Shade of Condense, opposite of Fill, pulling a spread Law down into something dense.
features: Skill: Compress
As an action, shrink an object to a tenth of its size without changing its weight or power.
Skill: Dense Spell
Once per short rest, condense an area spell into a single target: it deals double damage.
Ultimate: Point of Weight
Once per long rest, condense the air around a creature: 8d10 force and restrained (Strength save).
evolves: Condense a storm into a marble and you can release it later.
cost: You weigh three times what you look; boats and floors suffer.

requires: Level 23+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Ledger Spire is a brass mould no blade fits; your test is to hammer a sword into it without breaking the mould or the blade, while a clerk times you.
secret: You must have forged a perfect copy of someone else's work.
notice: [Shape forced. Legendary class: Mould-Breaker of the Ledger.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Forgotten Shade of Conform, the Law that forces one shape to match another.
features: Skill: Refit
In 1 minute, refit any armour to any wearer and restore it to full; your own armour grants +1 AC.
Skill: Matched Stance
Once per short rest, a creature you hit must copy your movement on its next turn (Strength save).
Ultimate: Uniform
Once per long rest, every weapon within 60 feet takes a shape you choose for 1 minute, losing its special properties.
evolves: Conform a fiend's armour to yourself and keep its resistances.
cost: You can only copy; nothing you make is ever your own design.

requires: Level 34+; pass Ulshaane's test at the top of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: Ulshaane's trace on the Shuffled Spire's top floor is a laughing voice asking a riddle with no answer; your test is to give a wrong answer so convincing the voice believes it.
secret: You must have talked a guard into arresting himself.
notice: [Nothing is clear. Legendary class: Riddle-Mouth Jester.]
blurb: Follows Ulshaane, the Unquiet Heart of Confusion, Dark's answer to Clarity, clouding rather than clearing.
features: Skill: Muddle
Creatures you hit have disadvantage on their next ability check or concentration save.
Skill: Wrong Way Round
Once per short rest, a creature within 30 feet attacks a random creature on its next turn (Wisdom save).
Ultimate: Babbling Hour
Once per long rest, enemies within 60 feet are confused for 1 minute, acting at random (Wisdom save each turn).
evolves: Confuse a god into forgetting a grudge and your Ultimate affects the target's memory too.
cost: You cannot explain anything plainly; allies have disadvantage following your instructions.

requires: Level 67+; pass Life's test at the top of the Horizon Spire
unlock: Life's trace at the top of the Horizon Spire is a cup on an open plain that is always full of something bitter; your test is to drink it for seven days without losing a meal.
secret: You must have survived a wound, poison or illness that should have killed you.
notice: [The body holds. Legendary class: Vessel of the Far Plains.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Hidden Shade of Constitution, the trait behind how much a body absorbs before Death or Decay has a say.
features: Skill: Deep Reserves
Your hit point maximum increases by your level, and you are immune to disease.
Skill: Shrug It Off
Once per short rest, reduce the damage of one hit by twice your level.
Ultimate: The Body Remembers
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot drop below 1 hit point and regain 20 hit points each turn.
evolves: Endure a realm above your Attunement for a month and Realm Pressure no longer strains you.
cost: You need twice the food and sleep; skipping either gives a level of exhaustion.

requires: Level 100+; pass Eirnois's test at the top of the First Spire
unlock: Eirnois's trace at the top of the First Spire is a point where every wind and river meets; your test is to stand in it for an hour while the Primordial pulls everything toward you.
secret: You must have brought a scattered family, crew or order back together.
notice: [All things come home. Legendary class: Lodestar of the First Spire.]
blurb: Follows Eirnois, the Forgotten Shade of Converge, opposite of Separation, pulling scattered things back to one point.
features: Skill: Draw In
As a bonus action, pull every creature you choose within 60 feet 30 feet toward you.
Skill: All Roads Home
Once per short rest, teleport every ally in the same realm to your side.
Ultimate: Single Point
Once per long rest, pull everything within 300 feet into one point: 20d10 force and restrained, then release.
evolves: Converge two realms for an hour and you can walk freely between them forever.
cost: Small objects drift toward you; you lose loose coins and gain strangers' trinkets daily.

requires: Level 12+; pass Mortheos's test at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Mortheos's trace at the top of the Fogglass Spire is a crossroads in the mist where three strangers wait; your test is to bring them to meet in the middle without any of them seeing you.
secret: You must have arranged a meeting between two people who would never otherwise have met.
notice: [Paths cross where you stand. Legendary class: Crossroads-Caller in the Fog.]
blurb: Follows Mortheos, the Nameless Shade of Convergence, a Void Law pulling separate things to a single point, opposed by Divergence.
features: Skill: Meeting Place
As a bonus action, swap places with an ally within 30 feet.
Skill: Converging Fire
Once per short rest, every ally who attacks one creature this round gets +1d6 damage.
Ultimate: Crossroads
Once per long rest, pull up to five creatures within 120 feet to a point you choose.
evolves: Converge two rival armies into a truce and you can call any creature you've met to you once.
cost: Lost strangers find you constantly and ask for directions.

requires: Level 67+; claim a relic of Life's remains at the top of the Horizon Spire
unlock: Life's remains lie unburied on an open plain at the top of the Horizon Spire; as its last trial, dig a grave with your hands and bury them under strange stars, then sit vigil until dawn.
secret: You must have prepared a stranger's body for burial.
notice: [What remains is yours to tend. Legendary class: Grave-Tender of the Far Field.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Forgotten Shade of Corpse, what is left once Death and Decay are done, and the raw material of Undead Summoning.
features: Skill: Good Material
Undead you raise have double hit points and keep their resistances from life.
Skill: Shield of the Dead
Once per short rest, as a reaction, a corpse within 30 feet rises and takes a hit meant for you.
Ultimate: Field of Graves
Once per long rest, every corpse within a mile rises and fights for you for 1 hour.
evolves: Lay a god's avatar to rest and its corpse can be raised once with divine power.
cost: The living smell the grave on you; disadvantage on Persuasion with the living.

requires: Level 78+; claim a relic of Nydoyr's remains at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Nydoyr's remains at the top of the Hollow Spire are a spreading black stain; as their last trial, let it touch you and hold it to a single spot on your skin for an hour.
secret: You must have broken a sacred oath and not repented.
notice: [Corruption accepted. Legendary class: Rot of the Hollow Oath.]
blurb: Follows Nydoyr, the Strange Shade of Corruption, the slow spread of Hell's influence into what was never Fiendish.
features: Skill: Spreading Taint
Creatures you hit gain vulnerability to necrotic until your next turn.
Skill: Turned Servant
Once per short rest, a summoned or charmed creature switches to your side for 1 minute (Charisma save).
Ultimate: Black Tide
Once per long rest, a 60 foot area is corrupted for 1 minute: enemies take 8d10 necrotic each turn and holy effects fail inside.
evolves: Corrupt a holy relic and it serves you with all its power.
cost: You become a little Fiendish; holy ground deals 2d6 radiant to you each turn.

requires: Level 45+; claim a relic of Kaniyr's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: Kaniyr's remains at the bottom of the Sunken Spire cower in a dark corner; as their last trial, flee from a monster you could beat while it mocks you, and do not look back.
secret: You must have left a fight to save yourself and lived to regret it.
notice: [You lived. That is enough. Legendary class: Craven of the Sunken Stair.]
blurb: Follows Kaniyr, the Shrouded Shade of Cowardice, Dark's answer to Courage, giving Fear the final word.
features: Skill: Run Away
You can Dash and Disengage as one bonus action.
Skill: Coward's Knife
Once per short rest, a creature chasing you takes 8d6 from a strike it never sees coming.
Ultimate: Live Another Day
Once per long rest, as a reaction to taking damage, take no damage and teleport up to a mile away.
evolves: Stand your ground once when everything says flee and you may choose to lose this class for courage.
cost: When frightened you must flee; you cannot choose to fight.

requires: Level 34+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Shuffled Spire is a wall caught mid-shatter; your test is to run into it as the floor shuffles and come out the other side unhurt.
secret: You must have survived a fall that should have killed you.
notice: [Impact. Legendary class: Wall-Breaker of the Shuffled Spire.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Quiet Shade of Crash, the instant a Projectile or Wall meets impact.
features: Skill: Ram
If you move at least 20 feet before hitting, deal an extra 3d6 and knock the target prone.
Skill: Hard Landing
Once per short rest, take no fall damage and deal it to creatures where you land.
Ultimate: Crater
Once per long rest, leap up to 300 feet and land: 10d10 in a 30 foot radius.
evolves: Crash through a fortress wall in one charge and you can crash through magical barriers.
cost: Once you start moving, you cannot stop until you hit something.

requires: Level 1+; claim a relic of Life's remains at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Life's remains at the top of the Milestone Spire are a single severed hand still carving a wooden bird; as its last trial, finish the carving with it, your hand guiding its fingers.
secret: You must have lost a hand or finger and kept working.
notice: [The hand remembers. Legendary class: Last-Grip Artisan.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Forgotten Shade of Crawling Hand, raising a single limb that keeps the skill it had in life.
features: Skill: Helping Hand
Raise a crawling hand from any corpse; it uses one tool proficiency the dead had.
Skill: Many Hands
Once per short rest, raise up to three hands at once.
Ultimate: Master's Grip
Once per long rest, a hand of a dead master grants you its skill for 1 hour.
evolves: Collect the hand of a famed artisan and keep its skill forever.
cost: Your own hands tremble; you have disadvantage on fine work without a hand to help you.

requires: Level 12+; pass Ryroael's test at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Ryroael's trace at the top of the Fogglass Spire is a vine that has grown over every mirror; your test is to let it climb you for a night and wake still yourself.
secret: You must have taken something over so slowly that its owner never noticed.
notice: [It spreads, quietly. Legendary class: Ivy-Slow Usurper.]
blurb: Follows Ryroael, the Quiet Shade of Creep, a slow spreading Law closer to Corruption than anything sudden.
features: Skill: Inch by Inch
Each round you stay near a creature, it takes 1d6 necrotic more than the round before, up to 6d6.
Skill: Overgrown Ground
Once per short rest, a 20 foot area spreads 10 feet each round for 1 minute, slowing enemies within.
Ultimate: Quiet Conquest
Once per long rest, a structure or area up to 300 feet across becomes yours over 1 hour: doors, traps and wards obey you.
evolves: Creep across an entire city unnoticed and you may claim its ward.
cost: You cannot act quickly; you can never take the Dash action.

requires: Level 45+; claim a relic of Divine's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: Divine's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire are pinned beneath a stone cross at the bottom of the descent; as their last trial, carry the cross back up three floors under the Abyss's pressure.
secret: You must have carried a heavy burden for someone else's faith.
notice: [The sign is lifted. Legendary class: Crossbearer of the Sunken Stair.]
blurb: Follows Divine, the Twin-Faced Shade of Cross, a symbolic shape Law tied loosely to the church's faith.
features: Skill: Sign of Faith
Your weapon or shield becomes a holy focus; fiends and undead take an extra 2d8 radiant from you.
Skill: Shoulder the Weight
Once per short rest, take all damage aimed at allies within 10 feet for 1 round, halved.
Ultimate: Raised Cross
Once per long rest, plant a cross: for 1 minute, undead and fiends within 60 feet cannot approach it.
evolves: Carry the cross through the Abyss's deepest floor and it becomes a weapon of Heaven.
cost: You must carry a heavy holy sign everywhere; your speed is reduced by 5 feet.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Hanoas's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Hanoas was killed by a tribe who misunderstood her; at the top of the Fogglass Spire, her last trial asks you to share a meal with three peoples who do not share a tongue.
secret: You must have lived among a race not your own for a year.
notice: [Welcomed. Legendary class: Hearthkeeper of Many Tongues.]
blurb: Follows Hanoas, the Forgotten Shade of Culture, the shared habits a Race builds around its easiest Laws.
features: Skill: Guest Right
You speak and understand any language after hearing it for a minute.
Skill: Borrowed Custom
Once per short rest, use one racial trait of a creature you've lived among.
Ultimate: Common Table
Once per long rest, hostile creatures within 60 feet must sit and parley for 10 minutes (Wisdom save).
evolves: Unite two warring peoples and gain a racial trait of each.
cost: Outsiders call you strange; you have no homeland that claims you.

requires: Level 1+; pass Life's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Life's trace at the top of the Milestone Spire is a wheel turning birth to death; your test is to walk it a full turn, being born and dying in the process.
secret: You must have witnessed a birth and a death on the same day.
notice: [The wheel turns. Legendary class: Wheelwalker.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Unknown Shade of Cycle of Life, the pairing of Life and Death as a single Law.
features: Skill: Turn of the Wheel
When a creature within 30 feet dies, you or an ally regain 1d6 hit points.
Skill: Back to Earth
Once per short rest, a dying creature becomes a sapling that heals allies 1d4 each turn.
Ultimate: Full Turn
Once per long rest, swap the hit point totals of two creatures.
evolves: Walk the wheel to the Primordial and gain a share of Infinatas' power.
cost: Every life you save must be balanced by a death you allow.

requires: Level 89+; claim a relic of Iron's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: Iron's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire hold a knife no longer than a finger; as its last trial, cut the thread hanging in the dark before you forget the floor below.
secret: You must have ended a fight with a single strike.
notice: [Short, swift, final. Legendary class: Unlit Quickknife.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Nameless Shade of Dagger, the shortest shape of Iron and Steel, favouring speed over reach.
features: Skill: Quick Edge
You can attack with a dagger as a bonus action, adding your ability modifier.
Skill: Opening Cut
Your first hit on each creature in a fight is a critical hit.
Ultimate: Thousand Cuts
Once per long rest, make ten dagger attacks in one turn.
evolves: Kill a god's avatar with a dagger and the dagger gains a Law of its own.
cost: You cannot wield weapons longer than a dagger.

requires: Level 78+; claim a relic of Lioluael's remains at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Lioluael's remains at the top of the Hollow Spire are a pair of open eyes floating where no light reaches; as their last trial, blindfold yourself, take the eyes' sight for an hour, and describe the thing that walks the hall with you.
secret: You must have spent thirty nights without any light, by choice.
notice: [The dark has edges now. Legendary class: Owl-Eyed Gloomwatcher.]
blurb: Follows Lioluael, the Hidden Shade of Dark Vision, a narrow refinement of Vision for seeing through Dark rather than further.
features: Skill: Gloom Sight
You see through magical darkness and the Void's lightlessness to 120 feet; you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision.
Skill: Shadow Mark
Once per short rest, mark a creature you see; it cannot hide from you or turn invisible to you for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Night Unveiled
Once per long rest, for 1 minute allies within 60 feet share your sight, and your attacks against creatures in darkness are critical hits on 18-20.
evolves: See Lioluael's killer in the dark and your sight pierces any disguise.
cost: Daylight is agony; you are blinded for 1 round whenever you enter bright light.

requires: Level 67+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Horizon Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Horizon Spire is a dart forever flying across an open plain under strange stars; your test is to outrun it to the horizon and catch it before it lands.
secret: You must have struck a moving target at long range in front of witnesses.
notice: [Speed over reach. Legendary class: Needlewind Skirmisher.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Unknown Shade of Dart, the smaller, faster cousin of Spear, trading reach for speed.
features: Skill: Flick
As a bonus action, throw up to three darts, each dealing 1d4 plus your Dexterity modifier and +1d6 piercing.
Skill: Needle Storm
Once per short rest, throw a storm of darts: every creature you choose in a 30 foot cone takes 6d6 piercing.
Ultimate: Horizon Shot
Once per long rest, throw a dart at any creature you have seen within a mile; it hits automatically for 12d6 and pins the target in place for 1 round.
evolves: Catch a falling star in flight and your darts carry starlight, dealing radiant damage.
cost: You cannot use heavy weapons or wear heavy armour.

requires: Level 56+; claim a relic of Ryran's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Ryran's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire stand armoured and waiting in the heartwood; as his last trial, defeat his corpse in an honourable duel, then kneel and offer it rest or service.
secret: You must have defeated a raised warrior and freed its soul rather than destroyed it.
notice: [A warrior's skill rises with the corpse. Legendary class: Grave-Sworn Captain.]
blurb: Follows Ryran, the Unknown Shade of Death knight, who raised mighty warriors with half their power and all their skill, at great risk.
features: Skill: Raise the Mighty
Once per long rest, raise a dead warrior of CR up to half your level; it keeps its combat skill and half its hit points.
Skill: Knightly Order
Once per short rest, your raised knight acts twice on its turn.
Ultimate: Order of Ash
Once per long rest, raise three knights for 1 minute; all three attack the same target with advantage.
evolves: Raise a legendary warrior willingly and it serves forever as your lieutenant.
cost: Each raise has a 1 in 6 chance to fail and the knight attacks you instead.

requires: Level 89+; claim a relic of Life's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire
unlock: Life's remains at the top of the Unlit Spire are slowly rotting on a stone bier; as their last trial, sit beside them, forgetting each floor behind you, until they are dust.
secret: You must have waited a decade for something you wanted.
notice: [It takes years. You have them. Legendary class: Patient Rot.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Turning Shape of Decay, the slow half of Death that claims over years rather than in an instant.
features: Skill: Slow Rot
Your hits deal 2d6 necrotic at the start of the target's turns for 1 minute, stacking up to three times.
Skill: Ages Pass
Once per short rest, an object up to a castle gate decays to dust in a round.
Ultimate: Years in a Moment
Once per long rest, a creature takes 20d10 necrotic as centuries pass over it (Constitution save for half).
evolves: Decay a god's discarded body and inherit a scrap of its Law.
cost: Anything you own decays faster; food spoils in hours.

requires: Level 56+; claim a relic of Ostroix's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Ostroix's remains at the top of the Heartwood Spire are a hole where the tree's rings simply stop; as their last trial, erase one memory you hold dear and never ask what it was.
secret: You must have destroyed every record of your own name.
notice: [Removed. No trace remains. Legendary class: Eraser of the Heartwood.]
blurb: Follows Ostroix, the Silent Shape of Deletion, opposite of Existence, erasing so fully that even Destruction leaves nothing to compare.
features: Skill: Strike Out
As an action, erase a nonmagical object up to the size of a door from existence.
Skill: Unwritten
