Once per short rest, as a reaction, delete a creature's last action: its effects never happened.
Ultimate: Erasure
Once per long rest, erase a creature of CR 15 or lower (Charisma save, 15d10 force on a success).
evolves: Delete a Law and stand in its empty place.
cost: Each use of Erasure deletes one of your own memories forever.

requires: Level 100+; claim a relic of Nyvais's remains at the top of the First Spire
unlock: Nyvais's remains at the top of the First Spire lead a horde of demons frozen mid-march; as the last trial, step into Nyvais's place and order them to finish their march.
secret: You must have bound a demon by its name.
notice: [The legion obeys. Legendary class: Pit-Legion Marshal.]
blurb: Follows Nyvais, the Unknown Shade of Demon, master of Hell's common denizens, weak alone but numerous enough to matter.
features: Skill: Lesser Horde
As an action, summon ten lesser demons for 1 hour; each has 30 hit points and +10 to hit.
Skill: Drilled Ranks
Your demons act together: when one hits, the others gain +2 damage until your next turn.
Ultimate: Endless Legion
Once per long rest, summon a thousand demons for 1 minute.
evolves: Command a Devil through its own legion and it bows to you.
cost: Hell always knows where you are, and devils resent your army.

requires: Level 34+; claim a relic of Zesaix's remains at the top of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: Zesaix's remains at the top of the Shuffled Spire lie unmoving in a floor that shuffles around them; as their last trial, sit with them in silence for a full day without leaving or speaking.
secret: You must have carried a grief for years without letting it go.
notice: [Heavy, and still standing. Legendary class: The Grey Weight.]
blurb: Follows Zesaix, the Tender Heart of Depression, Grief that never burns out, the heaviest and least wielded of Dark's splinters.
features: Skill: Heavy Air
Creatures within 10 feet of you have half speed and cannot take reactions.
Skill: Sorrow's Weight
Once per short rest, a creature you see cannot take actions on its next turn (Wisdom save).
Ultimate: Grey Tide
Once per long rest, enemies within 60 feet are incapacitated for 1 minute (Wisdom save each turn).
evolves: Heal from your grief and the class evolves into one of hope.
cost: Joy escapes you; you have disadvantage on Charisma checks.

requires: Level 12+; pass Liotheyr's test at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Liotheyr's trace at the top of the Fogglass Spire is a mirror showing what you want most; your test is to walk past it seven times without reaching for it.
secret: You must have given up something you deeply wanted for someone else.
notice: [Wanting, not reaching. Legendary class: Heart-Want Weaver.]
blurb: Follows Liotheyr, the Hidden Shade of Desire, a splinter of Light close to Love, wanting rather than reaching.
features: Skill: Wanting Gaze
Creatures that see you wish to be near you; they cannot attack you first unless they succeed on a Wisdom save.
Skill: Desired
Once per short rest, charm a creature for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Heart's Want
Once per long rest, show a creature its desire; it serves you for a day.
evolves: Grant a god its desire and gain its contract.
cost: You want too much; you can't refuse a gift.

requires: Level 12+; claim a relic of Lioniiel's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: Lioniiel's remains at the top of the Fogglass Spire are a cloud of grey mist; as their last trial, sit within it until you no longer hope, then climb back down anyway.
secret: You must have lost all hope once and come back.
notice: [Nothing reaches. Legendary class: Hope-Eater.]
blurb: Follows Lioniiel, the Tender Heart of Despair, Dark's answer to Hope, certain nothing reaches toward anything.
features: Skill: Crushing Truth
Creatures you hit can't regain hit points until your next turn.
Skill: Hopeless
Once per short rest, a creature has disadvantage on all rolls until your next turn.
Ultimate: Abandon All
Once per long rest, enemies within 60 feet lose all temporary hit points and bonuses.
evolves: Rekindle hope in another and the class becomes a beacon.
cost: Allies find you grim; disadvantage on encouragement.

requires: Level 56+; pass Iron's test at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Iron's trace at the top of the Heartwood Spire is a coin spinning forever on a ring of heartwood; your test is to catch it a hundred times without it touching the floor.
secret: You must have performed a feat of skill that astonished a crowd.
notice: [Precision. Legendary class: Quicksilver Hand.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Shrouded Shade of Dexterity, the trait behind precision that matters more than raw Strength to a Dagger or Bow.
features: Skill: Fine Hand
+2 to Dexterity checks, saves and attacks.
Skill: Quick Fingers
Once per short rest, take an extra action.
Ultimate: Flawless
Once per long rest, your next ten Dexterity rolls are 20.
evolves: Master Dexterity to its limit and gain an extra reaction each round.
cost: Your hands never stay still; disadvantage on Stealth.

requires: Level 34+; claim a relic of Gnome's remains at the top of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: Diamond's shattered remains are scattered across the Shuffled Spire's top floor, which reshuffles every hour; as his last trial, gather every shard before the floor moves them again, then set the last one in your own chest.
secret: You must have been rejected by your own parent or master and kept working anyway.
notice: [The unwanted child is wanted. Legendary class: Unwanted Gem-Heir.]
blurb: Follows Diamond, the Wild Spirit of Diamond, Gnome's strongest and least wanted child, broken to pieces long ago and hard for any Earth user to reach.
features: Skill: Faceted Skin
You gain +2 AC against weapon attacks, and slashing hits that roll a 1 on any die shatter on you for no damage.
Skill: Hardest Edge
Once per short rest, a weapon you hold becomes diamond for 1 minute: it ignores resistance and cuts through any nonmagical material.
Ultimate: Prism Burst
Once per long rest, explode into a storm of shards: 12d8 piercing in a 30 foot radius, then reform at full AC with 50 temporary hit points.
evolves: Earn Gnome's acknowledgement for Diamond and you may grow his shards into a fortress.
cost: Earth spirits resent you; Earth Law spells cast near you have a 1 in 4 chance to fail.

requires: Level 56+; pass Mornoor's test at the top of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: Mornoor's trace at the top of the Heartwood Spire is two identical rooms side by side; your test is to name the one difference between them before the tower's rings grow over the door.
secret: You must have settled a dispute by showing both sides how they differed.
notice: [The gap is measured. Legendary class: Measurer of Gaps.]
blurb: Follows Mornoor, the Hidden Shade of Difference, the Void's word for the gap between two things, concerned with comparison rather than loss.
features: Skill: Spot the Gap
As a bonus action, compare two creatures: learn which is stronger in each ability score and which resistances one has that the other lacks.
Skill: Close the Distance
Once per short rest, set your roll to equal an enemy's result on a contest or attack it just made against you.
Ultimate: Balance the Scales
Once per long rest, make the difference in hit points between two creatures you see zero: both end at the average of their totals.
evolves: Measure the gap between two Laws and you may slip a third between them.
cost: You compare everything; you can never accept a gift without judging its worth aloud.

requires: Level 23+; claim a relic of Cosmic's remains at the top of the Ledger Spire
unlock: Cosmic's Shade of Dimension died stretched across the Ledger Spire's top floor; as its last trial, find the fold in the hall that leads somewhere not part of this universe and come back out holding something from it.
secret: You must have been lost in a place larger on the inside than outside.
notice: [Space folds. Legendary class: Sideways Wanderer.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic's Shade of Dimension, the Unbound Shape, a piece of Cosmic stretched sideways to open room outside this universe.
features: Skill: Pocket Fold
You carry a folded room 20 feet across; enter or leave it as an action, taking up to five creatures.
Skill: Sidestep
Once per short rest, as a reaction to being hit, step sideways out of space: the hit misses and you reappear within 30 feet.
Ultimate: Outer Fold
Once per long rest, fold a 60 foot area out of the universe for 1 minute; nothing enters or leaves without your leave.
evolves: Map one fold fully and you can open a permanent door to it.
cost: Your shadow sometimes points the wrong way, and alien things notice you.

requires: Level 23+; pass Nymiune's test at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Nymiune's trace at the top of the Choir Spire is a single beam of light that never bends; your test is to walk its whole length without stepping aside, even when the choir sings you off course.
secret: You must have answered a question with the plain truth when a lie would have served you.
notice: [Exactly where aimed. Legendary class: Plumb-Line Striker.]
blurb: Follows Nymiune, the Shrouded Shade of Direct, a modifier Law that goes exactly where it is pointed.
features: Skill: Straight Line
Your attacks and spells ignore half and three-quarters cover and cannot be redirected.
Skill: Narrowed Spell
Once per short rest, collapse an area spell to one target: it takes the full damage plus 3d8.
Ultimate: Unbending Ray
Once per long rest, a 300 foot line of force: 12d10 to everything in it, passing through walls.
evolves: Hit a target across a whole realm and your strikes never miss a seen target.
cost: You cannot speak in hints; subtlety and Deception checks are at disadvantage.

requires: Level 100+; pass Thalvais's test at the top of the First Spire
unlock: Thalvais's trace at the top of the First Spire is a pit of primordial muck; your test is to wade in and fight a reflection of yourself who refuses to get dirty.
secret: You must have won a fight by cheating.
notice: [Unclean and proud. Legendary class: Mire-Fighter.]
blurb: Follows Thalvais, the Twin-Faced Shade of Dirty, opposite of Clean, more often inflicted than used.
features: Skill: Mud in the Eye
As a bonus action, foul a creature within 5 feet: blinded until the end of its next turn (Dexterity save).
Skill: Festering Ground
Once per short rest, turn a 30 foot area to filth: enemies there are poisoned and cannot heal for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Primordial Muck
Once per long rest, flood a 100 foot area with mire for 1 minute: enemies are restrained and take 6d10 poison each turn.
evolves: Defile a holy spring and live and your filth can unmake blessings.
cost: You are always filthy; nobles and temples turn you away.

requires: Level 1+; pass Aelraeth's test at the top of the Milestone Spire
unlock: Aelraeth's trace at the top of the Milestone Spire is a training dummy that moves on its own; your test is to stop it without harming it once.
secret: You must have defeated an enemy without injuring them.
notice: [Neutralised. Legendary class: Hamstringer.]
blurb: Follows Aelraeth, the Quiet Shade of Disable, aimed at a target's ability to act rather than its body.
features: Skill: Hobble
Your first hit on a creature each turn reduces its speed by 10 feet until your next turn.
Skill: Disarm
Once per short rest, as a reaction, make a creature drop what it holds (Strength save).
Ultimate: Stopped Cold
Once per long rest, a creature cannot take actions or reactions for 1 round (Wisdom save).
evolves: Disable a beast without harm a hundred times and Stopped Cold lasts a minute.
cost: You hesitate to finish anyone; your killing blows deal half damage.

requires: Level 45+; claim a relic of Aelluas's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: Aelluas's remains at the top of the Sunken Spire are a great engine taken apart and set in perfect rows; as the last trial, disassemble the guardian of the deepest floor and lay its parts beside theirs.
secret: You must have taken apart something no one knew how to open.
notice: [Whole into parts. Legendary class: Piece-Taker of the Deep.]
blurb: Follows Aelluas, the Strange Shade of Disassembly, the opposite of Assembly, unmaking without Destruction's waste.
features: Skill: Loosen
Constructs and objects you hit take an extra 3d8 and lose 1 AC until repaired.
Skill: Field Strip
Once per short rest, an armour, shield or weapon you touch falls into pieces (Strength save if worn).
Ultimate: Every Part Sorted
Once per long rest, a construct of any size falls apart into neat parts you can reuse.
evolves: Disassemble a god's engine and you can rebuild it as your own.
cost: You cannot use anything without first taking it apart once.

requires: Level 23+; pass Ultaur's test at the top of the Choir Spire
unlock: Ultaur's trace at the top of the Choir Spire is a hall that splits into two each time you look; your test is to follow every path at once until the choir sings your name twice.
secret: You must have parted from a companion so that both of you could succeed.
notice: [Paths part. Legendary class: Splitwind Herald.]
blurb: Follows Ultaur, the Unknown Shade of Divergence, opposite of Convergence, pushing things apart.
features: Skill: Part Ways
As an action, push every creature within 15 feet 20 feet away from you.
Skill: Split Spell
Once per short rest, a single-target spell you cast hits two targets.
Ultimate: Great Parting
Once per long rest, split an army, river or spell in two; nothing crosses the gap for 1 minute.
evolves: Diverge from your own fate and you can split yourself in two for an hour.
cost: Groups splinter around you; your party struggles to agree.

requires: Level 45+; pass Divine's test at the top of the Sunken Spire
unlock: Divine's trace at the top of the Sunken Spire is a crowd's prayer given shape; your test is to answer one prayer from the deep, without any god's help.
secret: You must have been worshipped, even once, by someone you helped.
notice: [Belief takes your shape. Legendary class: Faith-Made Saint.]
blurb: Follows Divine, the Quiet Keeper of Divine, belief siphoned from the Mortal Realm and shaped by the holy church rather than any real god.
features: Skill: Borrowed Belief
Gain temporary hit points equal to the number of creatures within 60 feet who believe in you, times 5.
Skill: Answered Prayer
Once per short rest, heal a creature 6d8 and end one condition.
Ultimate: Manufactured Miracle
Once per long rest, cast any cleric spell of 6th level or lower without a slot.
evolves: Earn a temple and your Miracle can be cast twice.
cost: If belief in you fades, so does your power.

requires: Level 78+; claim a relic of Eirvayr's remains at the top of the Hollow Spire
unlock: Eirvayr's remains at the top of the Hollow Spire are two identical corpses; as the last trial, defeat a hollow copy of yourself that hits exactly twice as hard.
secret: You must have done something twice that should only be possible once.
notice: [Twice. Legendary class: Twinfold Strike.]
blurb: Follows Eirvayr, the Strange Shade of Double, narrower cousin of Multiply, always exactly twice.
features: Skill: Second Echo
Once per turn, when you hit, the hit echoes for half damage.
Skill: Double Down
Once per short rest, double the result of one roll.
Ultimate: Twice Over
Once per long rest, take your turn twice.
evolves: Double a Law and the copy stays.
cost: You always pay double.
